meta.note: Trends and goals are computed on the GAP to the goalpost, then converted back to each outcome's own units. `rate` reads against the outcome's `trendRule`: for `proportional` it is the annual rate of change on the gap, for `linear` the annual change in the outcome's own units. Where an outcome carries `goalpostGain`, its goalpost is per location and ships as `g` beside the latest value.

nnm.label: Neonatal mortality
nnm.source: UN IGME 2025; sex split via GBD 2023

height.label: Mean height at age 19
height.goalpostBasis: this location's latest value plus the largest 25-year gain on record

math.label: Below PISA math minimum
math.source: OECD PISA 2025, Volume I Table I.B1.2a.47

skills.label: Below basic math skills
skills.source: Gust, Hanushek & Woessmann 2024, JDE 166, Table A4 col. 6

math_students.label: Below PISA math min., students
math_students.source: OECD PISA 2025, Volume I Tables I.B1.2a.35 and I.B1.2c.36
